video_title: Post Game Press Conference  l  Ron Hollan II  l  Pistons vs  Suns   10.05.26

quotes.speaker: Ron Holland II
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Holland II on the Pistons' defensive identity and team growth
quotes.excerpt: when we get locked in defensively as a team, we just go up levels
quotes.quote: When we finally picked things up, I really want to say it was the second half. We got off to a slow start, preseason and stuff like that happens. I think we allowed ourselves to control the game, made the right decisions. One thing I can say is, when we get locked in defensively as a team, we just go up levels and I think that's going to be hard for teams to put up with and deal with.
quotes.social_post: Ron Holland II says the Pistons defensive identity is the key to their success this year. When the team gets locked in on that end of the floor they go up levels and become very hard for opponents to deal with.

quotes.speaker: Ron Holland II
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Holland II praises teammate's performance and compares him to Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: I just seen AT compare him to Kyrie Irving his handles, and I can agree with that
quotes.quote: I was excited for him. We seen him this summer how he plays. I just seen AT compare him to Kyrie Irving his handles, and I can agree with that. He is amazing, he is about all the right things and had himself a moment tonight. Super proud of him and can't wait to see the season he has.
quotes.social_post: Ron Holland II is high on his teammates handles this season. He says he agrees with the comparison to Kyrie Irving and is excited to see the impact he makes for Detroit this year.

quotes.speaker: Ron Holland II
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Holland II on his intentional focus on playing with pace
quotes.excerpt: I went out there and when I was in the gym being intentional about working on pace
quotes.quote: I was watching a lot of film this summer and I went out there and when I was in the gym being intentional about working on pace instead of just talking about it. Putting bodies in front of me, being able to play as fast as I play but be able to slow the game down in my head. I think it showed tonight. Obviously I got ways to go, we got a long season, but I think tonight was a great showing for it.
quotes.social_post: Ron Holland II says he spent his summer being intentional about working on his pace. He focused on being able to play fast while learning how to slow the game down in his head.

quotes.speaker: Ron Holland II
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Holland II on J.B. Bickerstaff's defensive message to the team
quotes.excerpt: I think his message was wake up defensively, we know who we are
quotes.quote: I think his message was wake up defensively, we know who we are and let's just play Pistons basketball for real. Once we kind of got that message and woke up, y'all seen what happened after that.
quotes.social_post: Ron Holland II shares the message J.B. Bickerstaff gave the team to spark their turnaround. The coach told them to wake up defensively and get back to playing Pistons basketball.

quotes.speaker: Ron Holland II
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Holland II on the impact of rookie teammate's debut
quotes.excerpt: he got a taste of what Detroit is about pretty early
quotes.quote: He is active, he is an elite athlete, great character. He got a taste of what Detroit is about pretty early in the game. That was a welcome to Detroit moment pretty early in the game. It is going to be a fun year. Everybody loves the things that he is about, the player that he is, what he brings to the team and super excited to have him. It is going to be a fun one.
quotes.social_post: Ron Holland II is impressed with his rookie teammate after his debut. He calls him an elite athlete with great character and says he is already getting a taste of what Detroit is about.
